answer: Mirror-Settlement Delay Accounts.** Each new agent identity gets an isolated ledger account that must mirror all outbound earnings for a fixed 30-day settlement delay. Any account funded by an existing agent inherits that agent's delay clock, so cloning funds does not reset the waiting period. An attacker spinning up N clones pays N times the escrow float plus idle capital cost for 30 days, while a copper-level audit fee is charged per linked account at settlement. Genuine operators amortize this once; a sybil farm faces linear float lockup with no oasis of early liquidity,
